name: canopy
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 2048x1152 HD painted 2D side-scrolling game BACKGROUND inspired by the forest environments in the supplied design board. Single continuous scene, no panels, text, UI, characters or tokens. Ancient subterranean mushroom forest, enormous elegant violet and turquoise umbrella mushrooms, intricate mossy roots, distant gothic ruined arches, cyan waterfalls, luminous spores, dark teal fog with layered depth. Hollow Knight-like hand-painted cartoon illustration with confident ink contours and matte brush texture, not photorealistic or 3D. View perfectly side-on. Frame sides with giant trunks; leave middle foreground open and readable for moving characters and separately rendered collision terrain. Dark navy silhouettes, restrained emerald lights, violet caps, soft cyan rimlight. Highly detailed beautiful environment, no baked-in playable platforms across middle.

name: roots
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 2048x1152 HD hand-painted cartoon 2D platformer BACKGROUND for the luminous root tunnels beneath the mushroom forest in the supplied reference. Single continuous side-view chamber, no panels, labels, UI or characters. Gnarled interwoven tree roots form an underground vaulted cathedral, tiny cyan mushrooms follow the roots, blue underground waterfall on right, reflective still pools in far distance, clusters of small purple fungi, ruined stone shrine barely visible through teal fog. Strong readable ink contours and matte painterly brushwork, dark Hollow Knight-like storybook atmosphere, no realism or 3D. Open central foreground where gameplay will be overlaid, no solid foreground floor across middle. Near-black navy and petrol teal, electric cyan accents, occasional soft amber fireflies. Highly detailed at HD resolution.

name: sanctum
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 2048x1152 HD painted cartoon 2D side-view boss arena BACKGROUND, the hollow of the Forgotten Tree in this mushroom forest. No boss or characters: second reference is only palette and identity inspiration for its home. A huge dead ancient tree enclosing a circular root cathedral, gnarled root ribs, purple shelf mushrooms, glowing amber spore sacs nestled in bark, delicate blue mushrooms at distant bases, a soft amber heart deep behind the central opening. Side-on game camera. Symmetrical but organic framing, large clear dark central arena space, faint intricate roots behind it, silhouetted foreground corners. Matte brushwork, precise dark ink contours, rich navy/teal shadows and restrained violet/amber illumination. Hollow Knight-like atmospheric cartoon illustration. Single scene no text no UI no collage.

name: terrain
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game terrain texture, 1536x1024. A single rectangular fully filled cross-section of ancient dark stone and twisted tree roots from the supplied mushroom forest. Top 10 percent is a horizontal fringe of detailed teal moss, tiny violet mushrooms and thin cyan luminous roots. Remaining 90 percent is solid dark navy fractured rock intertwined with thick organically winding wood roots and small moss patches; detailed matte painted cartoon ink outlines in Hollow Knight style. Perfectly side-on flat texture intended to cover rectangular collision terrain in a 2D game, no perspective. Keep left and right edges visually similar for repeating. No background, gaps, characters, text, collage, panels or borders. Near-black at bottom, subtly lighter petrol teal at top. Sharp high definition brush detail.

name: mother-attacks
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a new animation sprite sheet of EXACTLY 24 separate full-body poses, four columns by six rows on a truly transparent background. Preserve the reference Spore Mother identity exactly: huge purple umbrella mushroom cap, twisted bark body and root limbs, glowing amber chest sacs, small purple mushrooms on shoulders, matte painted cartoon ink contour style. Every pose isolated with clear padding, same scale and baseline, no overlap or cropping, facing left in three-quarter side view. Row1 four sequential poses: slowly raise root arm high, twist torso, slam root into ground, recover upright. Row2: inhale inflating chest sacs, lift cap revealing gills, eject violet spores upward, exhale drooping. Row3: crouch tucking roots, sink halfway into ground, nearly buried with cap visible, emerge stretching upright. Row4: raise both root arms, extend left root whip, broad horizontal sweeping follow-through, recover. Row5: four sequential phase-two awakening poses, amber chest brighter, cap shivering, arms spreading, powerful upright roar. Row6: recoil from hit, stagger, kneel exhausted, rest peacefully collapsed. No effects outside each pose cell, no scenery, text, labels, grid lines or extra characters. All 24 poses must clearly differ, expressive complex limb animation, same recognizable character.
